title: BAE Systems delivers two AMPV 30s to Army built with internal funding in project the service didn’t formally request
summary: “We’re demonstrating how a proven combat vehicle platform can continue to evolve as the battlefield and technology change, without requiring the Army to start over every time a new capability emerges,” said Darby Dame, a company spokesperson. The post BAE Systems delivers two AMPV 30s to Army built with internal funding in project the service didn’t formally request appeared first on DefenseScoop .
